No — you can't expense the drone. Equipment you buy as a creator partner (including drones) is your own property; Westline doesn't reimburse, subsidize, or buy it back, and no approval route changes that. What would have worked instead is booking a rental for the specific shoot as a production allowance line (up to your tier ceiling, only if the brief budgeted it in advance), or using Creator Partnerships' free loaner pool if booked at least 5 business days ahead. Yes, you must disclose the sponsor: an on-screen "SPONSORED BY [BRAND]" label within the first 5 seconds (on screen 3+ continuous seconds, 4%+ of frame height) for video, plus "#Sponsored" or "#WestlinePartner" in the first two lines of the caption, and the segment must go to Editorial Standards at least 3 business days before publication — the sponsor has no say over the disclosure itself.</answer_markdown>
